title: PerformanceBoosted
description: Simple performance modpack to boost performance
body:
# PerformanceBoosted - Optimized Minecraft
PerformanceBoosted is a performance-focused modpack made to improve Minecraft's overall efficiency while not having a big amount of mods. This modpack includes a handpicked selection of mods to help boost FPS and reduce RAM utilization, ensuring a smoother and more stable performance gameplay. Whether you are playing on a gaming PC or a modest laptop, this modpack PerformanceBoosted works to make your game as smoothly as possible, without changing the default Minecraft features. This modpack is perfect for players that are looking for improved performance, without having a big amount of mods, or being complex to set up.

### Key Features
- Boost FPS and reduce lag: Whether you are on a singleplayer world or a multiplayer server,    PerformanceBoosted will improve FPS for you no matter what are you doing.
- Improved Game Stability: Using mods like FerriteCore help manage RAM usage leading to less crashes.
- Vanilla Friendly Visual Enchancements: Using Iris Shaders, you can put on your favorite shaders with a FPS boost!.
- Better Entity Handling: Using Entity Culling ensures that distant or hidden entities aren't rendered making a big FPS boost especially with lots of mobs.

### Why should you use PerformanceBoosted
If you're looking to improve your Minecraft experience without the hassle of dealing with a complex modpack, PerformanceBoosted is for you. It’s a lightweight and straightforward modpack that delivers performance improvements without cluttering your game with unnecessary mods.

### Notice
You may want to change some settings depending on your needs, your system, or just because you want. Using shaders, you might want to use a better graphics card, change your settings or change your resolution.

<details>
<summary>Mods</summary>
  
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Iris Shaders
- ImmediatelyFast
- Entity Culling
- FerriteCore

Dependencies/other mods:
- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config API
- Text Placeholder API

</details>
